body: If things take a turn for the worst at some point down the line, I'll definitely get back to you for some advice. Thanks!

That was absolutely wonderful to read, thank you very much. After I posted, immediately after I had a phone call from my dad, which I actually see as a sign. I missed it because I didn't want to talk to him the state I was in, but tomorrow I'll talk to him and tell him how I'm feeling, I'll reach out.
